mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 45 degrees near Badger Prairie County Park under a New Moon.

City updates highlight progress on the Mark Drive Reconstruction Project. Phase 2 work is actively replacing concrete curbs, sidewalks, and driveway aprons between North Nine Mound Road and Westlawn Avenue.
Looking at local events, trivia games are happening today at Hop Haus Brewing Co, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow brings live music to Paddy Mac's and yoga classes at Insight Wellness.
In police news, on Saturday morning officers responded to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue for a vehicle stopped in the road, where a driver was arrested for an O W I.
Over at Culver's, doors open today at 10:00 AM with Chocolate Heath Crunch featured as today's flavor of the day.
